description: Pinned corpora for compat-metrics and cmd/benchmark. Each project is fetched on demand into test_projects/<name> by `go run ./cmd/fetch-test-projects`; the checked-out sources are not committed to this repository (see .gitignore). `commit` is the exact pinned revision every reproducible run must use; `ref` is a human-readable tag/branch recorded for convenience and is re-resolved to `commit` at fetch time, never trusted on its own.

projects.name: composer-src
projects.notes: Representative framework/tooling corpus, not one of the required Mago benchmark workloads.

projects.name: psl
projects.notes: Required Mago benchmark workload (php-standard-library/php-standard-library). Pinned to the latest stable tag as of 2026-08-24; re-pin deliberately, do not silently track a moving branch. commit is the tag's peeled commit (6.2.1 is an annotated tag, whose own object SHA is 7334dda298859645bc64bce4a8129fe651ef67b1, not a commit).

projects.name: wordpress-develop
projects.notes: Required Mago benchmark workload (WordPress/wordpress-develop). Pinned to the latest stable tag as of 2026-08-24 (a lightweight tag, so this is already the commit). Large corpus; expect a multi-hundred-MB checkout even with a shallow clone.

projects.name: magento2
projects.notes: Required Mago benchmark workload (magento/magento2). Pinned to the latest stable tag as of 2026-08-24. Large corpus; expect a multi-hundred-MB checkout even with a shallow clone. commit is the tag's peeled commit (2.4.9 is an annotated tag, whose own object SHA is 614a428f70fcef830b02d37f633fedf273eeb667, not a commit).
